tagline: Leading marketer of branded consumer lawn and garden products in North America
hero_kpi_rationale: Net Sales is the primary KPI, representing the company's revenue-generating ability despite a 3.9% year-over-year decline due to lower Hawthorne segment sales and non-recurring sales in 2024

kpis.name: Net Sales
kpis.description: Revenue is declining due to lower sales in the Hawthorne segment and non-recurring sales of AeroGarden products in 2024

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Consolidated gross margin as a percentage of net sales
kpis.description: Gross margin improved by 6.7 percentage points due to lower material costs, reduced distribution costs, and operational optimization

kpis.name: Selling, General and Administrative Expenses
kpis.description: SG&A expenses increased by 7.9% due to higher investments in consumer activation activities in the U.S. Consumer segment

risks.title: Indebtedness
risks.score_rationale: The company's indebtedness could limit its financial flexibility and negatively affect its financial condition and ability to respond to market changes

risks.title: Regulatory Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to environmental laws and regulations and could be affected by changes in these regulations

risks.title: Litigation
risks.score_rationale: The company is involved in ongoing legal and administrative proceedings that could affect its finances and reputation

risks.title: Credit Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company has significant contractual obligations including Senior Notes and interest payments that could affect its financial condition

risks.title: Tax Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to tax laws and regulations and could be affected by changes in these regulations

risks.title: Macroeconomic and Geopolitical Conditions
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to risks related to high interest rates, inflationary pressures, geopolitical uncertainties, and changes in trade policies

risks.title: Hawthorne Segment Risks
risks.score_rationale: The Hawthorne segment continues to experience declining sales volume due to a prolonged cannabis oversupply and industry consolidation
